voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Tatlong katok sa pinto ng kuwarto ko. Pero tulog na ang lahat sa bahay.
lines.beat_before: hook: the house from above, ceiling off; three knocks: my door shudders, a light under it

lines.text: Galing kami sa probinsya, sa lamay ni Lolo. Siyam na gabi kaming nagbantay.
lines.beat_before: the wake in the province: the coffin, candles, white flowers, mourners

lines.text: Unang gabi pag-uwi, may kumatok sa pinto sa harap.
lines.beat_before: from above: night 1, three knocks at the front door; it shudders

lines.text: Pangalawang gabi, sa pinto ng kusina.
lines.beat_before: from above: night 2, the kitchen door

lines.text: Pangatlong gabi, sa kuwarto nina Mama. Papalapit.
lines.beat_before: from above: night 3, Mama and Papa's door; they sit up in bed

lines.text: Ngayong gabi, sa pinto ko na.
lines.beat_before: my POV from bed: under my door the light, and the shadows of two feet; three knocks

lines.text: Sabi ni Mama, huwag daw buksan. Baka hindi pa raw siya nakakapagpaalam.
lines.beat_before: my hand on the knob, trembling

lines.text: Binuksan ko. Sa dulo ng pasilyo, nakatayo si Lolo. Nakatalikod... pero nakaharap ang mukha niya sa akin.
lines.beat_before: the door opens on the hall: at its end Lolo, his back to me; his head turns round, his body does not
